about: Synthetic, de-identified blocks of Vault documents that are not CVs, for the document-type classification (decision 0021 (d)): what the phone sends as a `body` block when its heading lexicon cannot place the text. Invented; placeholders stand for names, places and numbers. `type` is the gold label.
